## Objective

Define deterministic low-frequency real modes with physical origin/axes/periods, immutable IDs, explicit smooth global extension and mm coefficients. Precompute mass/derivative Gram operators and fixed geometry-only gauges; retain effective rank and transformed derivative bounds.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 9.1, FA-07. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `flashalign Basis and coefficient state`
- `basis/gauge reference tests`

## Acceptance criteria

1. Stable wavevector ordering, duplicate +/- handling and basis normalization are tested.
2. Independent analytic/quadrature priors agree; basis changes transport precision/metrics by congruence.
3. Gauge rank deficiency, basis identity mismatch and grid/period changes fail explicitly; no hidden changing inlier-weight gauge.

## Blocking prerequisites

- L14 (`bd-01M2B1164EJ3NBPVAPB6NQG8WR`): FA-L14: Integrate and qualify the 12-parameter affine engine
- B05 (`bd-01M2B114AZEZ1G6Q44G59F3F1M`): FA-B05: Freeze fixture, tolerance and benchmark evidence specifications

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
